scope:
Conditional He trap kinetics along archived chronological receiver T(t).
Run with numpy/scipy: python thermal_trapping.py
No measured trapped fraction, trap-energy distribution or repair work is inferred.

model.trap_law: S=exp[-integral nu exp(-E/kT) dt]; single first-order trap, no retrapping or irradiation detrapping
model.acceptance: 95% survival of the He number-weighted cohort, assuming all selected atoms initially occupy the same trap type
model.covered_cohort: Only arrivals whose complete postimplant hold interval fits the archived -600..4000s profile. No omitted-tail renormalization is used in the all-cohort bounds.
model.missing_interval: Bracket unrecorded durations at1000K and1668K. These are explicit conditional temperature bounds, not a reconstructed trajectory or credible interval.
model.surface_temperature: Front-surface T(t) used for micron implants, plus0.1K old-tail allowance. Prompt upper curve replaces the first0.25s; newly implanted atoms do not encounter their own earlier prompt.
model.mobile_kernel: erfc(depth/(2sqrt(integral Ddt))) in an absorbing-front half-space. Jung mobile/orientation D reference; mean projected depths omit straggling. Neither a trapped fraction nor real total leakage is inferred.
model.energy: E is an activation barrier, not the input work per recovered atom or defect.
